subjective.text: Patient has had diarrhea for three days with watery stools and abdominal pain on the left side.
Patient mentions feeling weak and shaky without fever or vomiting.
Patient had a Chinese takeaway meal four days prior to onset of symptoms.
Patient works as an accountant and has not been able to work due to frequent trips to the toilet.
Patient does not smoke or drink alcohol.
Patient has asthma but it is well-controlled with an inhaler.

objective.text: No physical examination findings mentioned by the doctor during this consultation.

assessment.text: Patient has gastroenteritis possibly caused by a viral infection following a Chinese takeaway meal.

plan.text: Recommend conservative management including hydration and rest; advise taking time off work for two to three days as the infection clears from his system.
Advise patient to return if symptoms do not improve in three to four days or if they worsen.
